FYI, we have a venue change our Friday work sessions.  We will meet in Plant and Environmental Sciences 2005.

Unfortunately another group nabbed Wickson 2124 on Fridays for the rest of the quarter.  I have reserved PES 2005 for the rest of the quarter, but NOT 10/12 or 10/19, when it was already reserved.  If you have access to a good room (conference-style, with a good projector setup, fits ~20 people) that you can reserve for those dates, please email me directly.

Hi Folks,

I'm happy to be part of the group and will pop in in person when I can, which will not be this week, sadly enough. But to put it out there, mostly these days I'm using R to do demographic modeling. I'm using the popbio library, some little simulations, and some other neat stuff in aster.  I'd be happy to pass on what I've learned at some point or just connect with other folks who do demographic models. 

Cheers, Kara
